errors.evidence: The largest segment (76.9%, red) is labeled "Течни горива" (Liquid fuels) in the legend and chart, not "Възобн. и биоорива" (Renewable and biofuels).
The segment representing 18.5% ("Електрическа енергия") is colored light blue/teal, not pink ("розов").
The segment representing 4.0% (purple) corresponds to "Възобн. и биогорива" (Renewable and biofuels), not "Твърд гориво" (Solid fuel).
The segment representing 0.4% corresponds to "Твърди горива" (Solid fuels), not "Природен газ" (Natural gas).
The smallest segment representing 0.2% corresponds to "Природен газ" (Natural gas), not "Течни горива" (Liquid fuels).

errors.text_span: Визуално, сегментът, представляващ „Възобн. и биоорива“, е най-висок и изместен напред от останалите сегменти.
errors.evidence: The chart is a standard 2D pie chart. No segment is "highest" (implying a 3D effect) or "offset forward" (exploded). This is a complete fabrication of visual features.
